name: competition1
frozen_by: issue #42 (coordinator-approved 2026-11-19; all five open decisions adopted as recommended)
evaluation_seeds_note: 5 seeds chosen per the density survey: 200/200 gives ~9-10 decisions per 30-day window per seed, so 5 seeds aggregate to ~45-50 decisions (m >= 30, robust ranking). Values 71-75 are the recommended range from issue #42 / COMPETITION.md 5.5.

competition.max_training_rows_note: Participant-side constraint (COMPETITION.md 3.3, 50000-500000). Not enforced by the organizer evaluator.
competition.partition_note: No partition in the v1 primary metric: the whole market is one partition, so macro_daily_replay_fee_yen is the plain daily mean. occupation/region partitioning can be added in a later revision without changing the data version.
competition.evaluation_note: Half-open [150, 180) = 30 evaluation days, evaluated on MULTIPLE days via the full replay evaluator (fallback single-day is not used because replay is implemented). D_eval_end + H = 180 + ~90 <= 280 = observation_end_exclusive.

baseline.source: warmup-trained logistic models (model_apply_score / model_screen_score / model_decision_score) refitted from observed warmup referrals and applied to evaluation-day candidates
baseline.order: p_decision_baseline * fee_if_decided_yen descending; ties by (day_dt, user_id, item_id) ascending
